help:
usage: pipeline.py [-h] --reflectance REFLECTANCE --usgs USGS --out OUT
                   [--mask-boxes MASK_BOXES] [--components COMPONENTS]
                   [--max-fit-pixels MAX_FIT_PIXELS] [--chunk-rows CHUNK_ROWS]
                   [--noise-fit-pixels NOISE_FIT_PIXELS] [--rows ROWS]
                   [--quality-mask QUALITY_MASK] [--force-quality-mask]
                   [--seed SEED]

EMIT Oman ophiolite reflectance pipeline

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --reflectance REFLECTANCE
                        EMIT L2A reflectance netCDF
  --usgs USGS           Directory of USGS spectra
  --out OUT             Output directory
  --mask-boxes MASK_BOXES
                        JSON exclude boxes (row0, row1, col0, col1)
  --components COMPONENTS
                        PCA and MNF components
  --max-fit-pixels MAX_FIT_PIXELS
                        Max sampled spectra for the PCA fit, MNF signal
                        covariance, and matched-filter background
  --chunk-rows CHUNK_ROWS
                        Downtrack rows read per chunk
  --noise-fit-pixels NOISE_FIT_PIXELS
                        Max sampled along-track difference spectra for the MNF
                        noise covariance (default max-fit-pixels/2)
  --rows ROWS           Downtrack row subset START:STOP (half-open), e.g.
                        0:256
  --quality-mask QUALITY_MASK
                        EMIT L2A MASK netCDF; cloud/cirrus/water/spacecraft
                        flags, used only if shape and lat/lon match
  --force-quality-mask  Use --quality-mask when only the shape matches (skip
                        the lat/lon footprint check)
  --seed SEED           Random seed for the fit samples
